title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
abstract: arXiv:2610.28753v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. translated_title: 理解限价订单簿状态空间基础模型的内部工作机制
translated_abstract: 自回归基础模型通过生成限价订单簿（LOB）的消息流，提供了最先进的市场模拟能力。然而，在不了解其内部工作机制的情况下，研究方向难以收窄，其在真实交易环境中的实际应用也仍存在不确定性。因此，本研究探究了这些模型究竟从市场微观结构中学到了什么。我们发现，类似于序列模型在游戏中构建对棋盘的内部表示，一个在八只美国大盘股的标记化消息流上进行自回归训练的8.2M参数Mamba-3状态空间模型，学会了市场及其动态的内部表示。特别是，订单流不平衡（短期价格波动的核心驱动因素）能够以 $R^2 \approx 0.59$ 的精度被解码，远高于对照组和基线模型。这种表示还能扩展到未见过的股票，表明这些模型学到了通用的表示。
tldr: 本研究揭示了8.2M参数的Mamba-3状态空间基础模型在限价订单簿消息流上自回归训练后，内部学会了市场及其动态的通用表示，其中订单流不平衡这一短期价格波动核心驱动因素可被以R²≈0.59的高精度解码，且该表示可泛化至未见过的股票。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space foundation model trained autoregressively on limit order book message streams learns general internal representations of market dynamics, decoding order-flow imbalance—a key driver of short-horizon price moves—at R² ≈ 0.59, with the representation generalizing to unseen stocks.
